```{r setup, include=FALSE}
library(readr)
library(dplyr)
```

```{r}
trajectory <- read_csv("data/processed/glm_trajectory_type_threatlevel_convicted_ACS_MPI.csv") %>%
  filter(window >= -7)

n_days_pre <- abs(min(trajectory$window)) * 60
n_days_post <- (max(trajectory$window) + 1) * 60 + 1

n_arrests_pre <-trajectory %>%
  filter(window < 0) %>%
  group_by(region) %>%
  summarize(n_arrests_pre = sum(n_arrests))

n_arrests_post <- trajectory %>%
  filter(window >= 0) %>%
  group_by(region) %>%
  summarize(n_arrests_post = sum(n_arrests))

pop_MPI <- trajectory %>%
  filter(window == 0 & method == "CA" & convicted == 0 & threat_level == 0) %>%
  group_by(region) %>%
  summarize(pop_MPI = sum(pop_MPI))

tab <- merge(merge(n_arrests_pre, n_arrests_post), pop_MPI) %>%
  mutate(per_1k_pre = n_arrests_pre/pop_MPI*1000 / n_days_pre * 60,
         per_1k_post = n_arrests_post/pop_MPI*1000 / n_days_post * 60) %>%
  arrange(-pop_MPI)

tab_EUCA <- tab %>%
  filter(region == "EUCA")
tab_nonEUCA <- tab %>%
  filter(region != "EUCA")
tab_totals <- data.frame(t(colSums(tab_nonEUCA[-1]))) %>%
  mutate(per_1k_pre = n_arrests_pre/pop_MPI*1000/ n_days_pre * 60,
         per_1k_post = n_arrests_post/pop_MPI*1000/ n_days_post * 60)
tab_totals$region = "All Non-EUCA"

tab_totals_all <- data.frame(t(colSums(tab[-1]))) %>%
  mutate(per_1k_pre = n_arrests_pre/pop_MPI*1000/ n_days_pre * 60,
         per_1k_post = n_arrests_post/pop_MPI*1000/ n_days_post * 60)
tab_totals_all$region = "All"

rbind(tab_EUCA, tab_nonEUCA, tab_totals, tab_totals_all) %>%
  mutate(add_disp = per_1k_post-per_1k_pre,
         mult_disp =  exp(log(n_arrests_post/n_days_post) - log(n_arrests_pre/n_days_pre))) %>% 
  mutate(per_1k_pre = round(per_1k_pre, 1),
         per_1k_post = round(per_1k_post, 1),
         add_disp = round(add_disp, 1),
         mult_disp = round(mult_disp, 1)) %>% 
  filter(region %in% c("EUCA", "All Non-EUCA", "All"))
```
